purpose: Proposed automation acceptance plans for the standalone synthetic shop. No live schedule, account, or app behavior is configured by this file.

global_policy.outputs: Local drafts, alerts, test run requests, and receipts inside an isolated fixture namespace only.
global_policy.approval_boundary: A routine cannot promote its proposal into a real supplier order, payment, outgoing message, production write, or live schedule.
global_policy.eligibility_recheck: Re-read source revisions and lifecycle eligibility when claiming work and before committing a local output.
global_policy.atomicity: Claim and commit by a supported atomic mechanism. An instruction to avoid duplicate work alone is not concurrency control.
global_policy.unknown_policy: Missing prices, unit conversions, authorization, company ownership, and conflict policy remain explicit blockers.
global_policy.clock: Use an injected test clock. Record UTC timestamps and the local date and timezone that drove calendar decisions.
global_policy.test_status: All plans are NOT_RUN until executed by a declared adapter. A configured fake scheduler is separate from an observed timed run.
global_policy.fixture_boundary: These are synthetic test policies. They do not approve product behavior or configure app automations.

plans.name: Draft a low-stock requisition

trigger.event: A committed stock or reservation fact changes available stock across its reorder threshold.
trigger.debounce: Coalesce repeated facts by variant, location, and business revision.

eligibility: The stock identity has a declared stock unit and reorder threshold.
Available stock excludes quarantine and active reservations under the fixture policy.
No unresolved requisition exists for the same logical shortage.
Reconcile existing open draft and approved incoming quantities under an explicit fixture supply policy before proposing additional stock. Incoming supply does not change on-hand stock.
proposed_outputs: One local draft requisition with variant, location, shortage, unit, source revision, and candidate supplier offers.

idempotency.scope: Isolated fixture shop and run namespace.
idempotency.dedupe_rule: Atomically keep at most one unresolved requisition per open_output_key. New shortage revisions update or supersede that requisition with history. Replay returns the existing output and receipt.
idempotency.revision_rule: Include a source business revision only when it changes the proposed action. A repeated event or unchanged scheduler observation keeps the same key.
idempotency.completion_record: Persist output IDs and a terminal receipt. If a crash occurs between them, recover by the same key.
idempotency.namespace_rule: Keep test_namespace stable across worker restarts and duplicate observations. Give each independent regression run its own namespace. Attempt IDs do not enter logical dedupe keys.

retry_policy.retry_key: same logical key for every attempt

failure_handling: Keep the original input and all attempt receipts.
Stop after the retry budget. Create one local attention item with the exact prerequisite and next action.
Permission denials, malformed input, unknown price, cancelled job, and absent product policy do not receive blind retries.
test_boundaries: Use a fake scheduler and a local draft sink inside the scenario namespace.
Never place an order, send a supplier or customer message, redeem credits, make a payment, configure a live schedule, or write a production database.
The plan alone does not prove a configured routine or a timed execution.
plans.action_guard: The routine can propose local outputs only. Any external promotion needs separate explicit authority and a supported execution path.
positive_tests: Cross the threshold with an accepted scenario stock movement and obtain one correctly sized draft.
Replay the event and restart the worker. The draft ID remains the same.
negative_tests: Stock above threshold creates no requisition.
Quarantined material does not satisfy the threshold.
A duplicate event creates no duplicate draft.
blocked_if: An app assertion requires an approved product policy that the pinned target lacks.

plans.name: Draft a material-shortage purchase plan

trigger.event: A committed job-line demand or allocation revision changes the unmet quantity.

eligibility: The synthetic test policy includes active and awaiting_materials jobs only. A scheduled job requires an explicit planning_enabled flag in the scenario copy. No such flag is inferred from the calendar.
The job is not on_hold, completed, or cancelled. Retained historical unallocated_qty on closed jobs creates no new demand.
The demand unit and each supplier sell unit have a declared conversion.
Reconcile known approved incoming supply and existing unresolved plans before proposing another purchase. Do not order again merely because current on-hand stock is short.
proposed_outputs: One local proposed purchase plan grouped by supplier.
Known-price subtotal, unknown-price count, and pending-total state.
An explicit remainder after sell-unit rounding, without silently over-allocating job demand.

plans.name: Create a local stale-job reminder

trigger.dst_policy: One occurrence per local date. Repeated scheduler observations deduplicate by local date.

eligibility: The job is active or awaiting materials.
Its last meaningful activity exceeds the fixture stale interval.
No reminder exists for that job, activity revision, and local date.

Use a synthetic stale interval of three business days after last meaningful activity. The adapter must define its business-day calendar and local-date comparison. No live scheduling preference is implied.
proposed_outputs: One local reminder with the last activity time, job owner, unmet condition, and next suggested review.

eligibility: The original operation key and sender and receiver identities remain valid.
The failure is transient and the operation was not cancelled, rejected, or superseded.
A declared sync protocol and conflict policy exist.

plans.name: Plan a nightly isolated regression run

trigger.dst_policy: Use one run key per Denver local date. On the fall repeated hour, the second 01:30 observation reuses the first key. If a configured time is nonexistent, require a declared skip or shift policy.

eligibility: A pinned fixture checksum, app revision, adapter version, isolated database, and test transport are available.
No production path, live credential, or real output sink is accessible.
The previous run has terminal receipts or an explicit recovered stale-run record.
proposed_outputs: One local regression run request for SCN-001 through SCN-028.
A report that separates fixture validation, local source behavior, sync behavior, proposed workflow cases, and blockers.
